one_liner: Cloudflare provides CDN, DNS, security, and edge compute infrastructure APIs.

evidence.claim: API tokens are created self-serve from the Cloudflare dashboard (My Profile > API Tokens or Manage Account > API Tokens).
evidence.quote: From the [Cloudflare dashboard ↗](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens/), go to **My Profile**>**API Tokens** for user tokens. For Account Tokens, go to **Manage Account**>**API Tokens**.

evidence.claim: Authentication uses Bearer tokens sent in the Authorization header against api.cloudflare.com.

notes: Legacy Global API key auth still exists (labeled legacy) alongside modern scoped API tokens. GraphQL Analytics API is separate from the REST v4 API; a GraphQL MCP server is documented in the changelog. R2 S3-compatible access requires purchasing R2 first ('You must purchase R2 before you can generate an API token'), but the core API is free-tier accessible. New tokens use the cfut_ scannable prefix format.
